sun_and_moon.ask: Drop the twinkle an octave up where a phrase rests; the bell alone, uneven by hand, is enough. Let the rest be silent.

gentle_tips.ask: Cut the twenty-two tips to the dozen a painter truly needs; drop those that only point at menus, like Settings and Tips or Worth a Look Here.

marginarium.ask: On the first page, show one drawing, not twenty-four, and no eggs; let the story be the way in.

replay.name: Replay Making-of
replay.note: One menu, two replays side by side. The finished painting's bar stays quiet.
